method: Manually drawn polygon outlines. Foreground PNGs are transparent copies of the original background pixels, derived at runtime; these are approximate masks, not semantic segmentation.

layers.name: Foreground hoop player in red trousers

seurat.name: A Sunday on La Grande Jatte

layers.name: Fountain basin and pedestal
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Approximate stone/water/pedestal outline. Paint includes the opaque basin surface; nearby seated people, the front flower pot and the green-dress woman are erased from this layer. Thin water streams and some small stone gaps are omitted; tiny leaves along the rim remain approximate.

layers.name: Blue café umbrella and pole
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Canopy is the useful opaque foreground. A narrow registered pole is retained; no café diners or chairs are included. Pole and canopy borders are approximate at one-pixel resolution.

layers.name: Green-canopy drinks cart
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Manual canopy, frame, counter, goods and solid lower body. Wheels are rings with erased centers. Open display gaps are retained rather than filling the entire cart bounding box; rail thickness and small jars are approximate.

layers.name: Teal-canopy juice cart
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Includes canopy, uprights, visible drinks, solid cart and the near wheel. Leaves the open serving gap transparent. The far wheel is mostly hidden by nearby people and is intentionally omitted. The foreground white-shirted child is erased from the cart body; child/cart overlap is approximate.

layers.name: Accordion player
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Person and accordion are one foreground group. The inter-leg gap is erased. Fingers, cap brim and thin instrument edges are simplified.

layers.name: Double-bass player and instrument
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Player and double bass form one group; the tall neck and opaque instrument body are included. Bow/string detail, hands and the rear foot may be a pixel off.

layers.name: Foreground shopper in blue shirt and shorts
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Back-facing blue shirt, shorts and feet. The adjacent stall and shopper's bag are excluded. Hands and the narrow gap between calves are approximate.

layers.name: Foreground woman in navy coat
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Opaque coat and legs, with an inter-leg gap. The nearby lamp post, flowers and other people are not part of the mask. Dark hair/coat boundaries are approximate.

layers.name: Man in a pale suit near the bicycle
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Suit, hands and shoes traced as one person. The adjacent bicycle and cyclist are excluded. Dark trousers/ground contact and hand shape remain approximate.

layers.name: Woman in green by the fountain
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Person and green dress only. No potted flowers, basin stones or source water are included. The right arm blends with the fountain edge and is an approximate outline.

layers.name: Yellow-shirt dancer
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Includes raised arms and shorts with separated legs. The dancer is small; fingertips and toe boundaries are deliberately simple polygons.

layers.name: Man in blue walking beside the drinks cart
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Blue jacket, dark trousers and shoes. Yellow carried items and the spotted dog are excluded. Walking-leg overlap and fingertip detail are approximate.

layers.name: Large blue market canopy
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Complete visible roof contour; poles, underlying stall and customers are separate objects and excluded. Edge folds are approximate.

layers.name: Yellow striped market canopy
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Complete visible striped roof; market produce, supports and shoppers are excluded. Some decorative edge scallops are omitted.

layers.name: Cream canopy above central stall
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Opaque canopy roof silhouette only, excluding the background walking person and merchandise. The visible roof is treated as a whole object, not a full stall group.

layers.name: Teal canopy on the left
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Full visible roof outline. Stall poles and customers below it are deliberately excluded; a few edge folds remain approximate.

layers.name: Foreground cream market canopy
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Complete foreground canopy roof. This is a canopy object, without its underlying stall shelves or shoppers. Fine fringe folds are approximate.

layers.name: Seated visitor in blue at fountain
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Whole visible seated person including bent blue-clothed legs. Fountain stone behind the person is excluded. Small hands and bent-knee boundary are approximate.

layers.name: Seated visitor in white vest
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Whole visible seated person; the foot/leg gap is erased. Hat brim, fingers and overlaps with the neighboring visitor/child are approximate.

layers.name: Child in white dress at fountain
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Dress, hair, arms and visible legs. Narrow leg gap is erased; no fountain or flower-pot rectangle is included. Tiny facial and limb edges are approximate.

layers.name: Green-jacket cyclist
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Whole visible cyclist person; bicycle is a separate object and excluded. Limbs partially hidden by handlebars are not reconstructed. Hat and pedal-foot boundary are approximate.

layers.name: Yellow-shirt visitor near bicycle
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Head, yellow shirt, shorts and walking legs. Raised right hand and leg gap retained approximately. Bunting in front may cover a few leg pixels; no floor shadow is included.

layers.name: Coral-dress visitor beside fountain
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Whole visible standing person with coral clothing and legs. Adjacent fountain and chairs are excluded; detailed hand and heel shapes remain approximate.

layers.name: Visitor in brown jacket and blue skirt
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Whole visible brown-jacket/blue-skirt person, excluding the neighboring blue-hat visitor. Fine handbag strap and hands are omitted; hem and shoe contours are approximate.

layers.name: Cloth-covered central podium
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Opaque cloth silhouette only. The loose rope on the floor and cast shadow are excluded. Hem and cloth fold edge are approximate.

layers.name: Right red-striped awning and stall
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Awning plus visible opaque wooden stall front and beams. Background audience gaps between supports remain open. Cropped right edge and panel decoration are approximate; no audience mass is included.

layers.name: Left stone entrance and gate
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Stone portal and its dark gate are one opaque structural group. The inner gate is treated as opaque at this resolution; narrow bar openings and small wall chips are not segmented. Surrounding audience and floor shadow are excluded.

layers.name: Foreground brass tuba
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Brass bell and curved pipe; musician/audience largely excluded. The small open loop is erased. Reflections and dark bell interior remain part of the instrument; the silhouette is approximate.

layers.name: Purple foreground contestant
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Tall hat, cloak and feet only. Small hand/leg gaps and narrow hat brim are simplified; cast shadow is excluded.

layers.name: Green contestant near entrance
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Individual small green contestant. Fine arms and decorative headgear are simplified; no surrounding floor is intentionally included.

layers.name: Red contestant behind podium
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Headgear, tunic and legs. Small source silhouette is approximate at1–2px; elongated cast shadow is excluded.

layers.name: Gold contestant holding a prop
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Person and short held prop. Fine hand/prop details and inter-leg gap are approximate; floor circle and shadow are excluded.

layers.name: Brown contestant on right
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Single contestant with compact arm/hat outline. The small decorative prop, toes and narrow leg gap are simplified.

layers.name: Red foreground contestant
layers.silhouetteLimitations: Head, red clothing and feet only; near-circle floor paint and cast shadow are excluded. Fine facial/arm details are approximate.

layers.name: Blonde guest in red gown
layers.limitations: Visible red gown/hair; adjacent clasped hands and overlapping gowns are approximate.

layers.name: Curly-haired guest in rose gown
layers.limitations: Visible body only; gown overlap with other guests is baked into source art.

layers.name: Dark-haired guest in red cape
layers.limitations: Partly behind central gown; trace uses visible silhouette, not reconstructed anatomy.

layers.name: Robot guard and control console
layers.limitations: Visible robot head and console body only; the separate green hat and connecting barrier ropes are excluded. Hidden limbs are not reconstructed.

layers.name: Green-hatted bearded guest
layers.limitations: Hat, beard, hand and visible coat; actual ground-contact feet are hidden by lower crowd.

layers.name: Foreground witch in purple cloak
layers.limitations: Cloak continues beyond crop; bottom anchor512 is a clipped visible-silhouette edge, not known feet.

layers.name: Pale-collared court guest and fan
layers.limitations: Person and separately traced folding fan. Visible silhouette remains approximate at fine hair and hand edges; lower garment is clipped by the source crop.

layers.name: Moustached guest in pale coat
layers.limitations: Visible pale coat/head; lower outline meets overlapping foreground hair.

layers.name: Left queue witch and broad hat
layers.limitations: Left edge is source crop; hat/visible coat only, no inferred off-image anatomy.

layers.name: Central-right brass barrier post
layers.limitations: Post only; connecting rope deliberately excluded to keep one object anchor.
